title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Fruity Blackcurrant Honeydew 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Sweet, sharp and succulent, this Seriously Fruity combination of intensely sweet Blackcurrants and fresh and mellow Honeydew Melon has to be tasted to be believed. This convenient 100ml shortfill bottle really helps your favourite e-liquid go the distance and comes with 25ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. For example, adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nic shots will create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. This e-liquid’s 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , box mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
